```{r}
dados = read.csv("ExtentIce.csv")
```

```{r}
obser = dados$SeaIceExtent.km2. |> as.ts()
plot(obser)
```
```{r}
library(rugarch)
```

```{r}
diff1 = obser |> diff()

plot(diff1)
```
```{r}
armapart = arima(diff1, order = c(1, 0, 1), seasonal = list(order = c(1, 0, 0), period = 182))
```

```{r}
residuosarma = armapart$residuals

plot(residuosarma)
```

```{r}
residuosarma_scaled = scale(residuosarma) |> as.ts()
plot(residuosarma_scaled)
```


```{r}
spec = ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    garchOrder = c(2, 2), #I've tried a few, starting at (1,1). those yielded the "best" model
    model = "sGARCH"),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(1,1), #the parameters previously identified using auto.arima()
    include.mean = F)
)

modelo = ugarchfit(spec, residuosarma_scaled)
```

```{r}
modelo
```


```{r}
modelo@fit$residuals |> as.ts() |> plot()
```
